semantics.definition: The tunnel behind a system’s arch: white walls that dissolve into dust the deeper they go, seen only through the arch, with rings of lime that run along it while a character flies in.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one gateway every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Carry a character from its arch into a system.

measure.behind: how far behind the character ripples start
